items.problem: The UWP source manifest was copied into a nested folder (BackgroundTask/BackgroundTask/Package.appxmanifest) rather than the WinUI 3 project root, creating two manifests and confusion about which one the build uses.
items.evidence: Two Package.appxmanifest files exist in the migrated tree; only app/BackgroundTask/Package.appxmanifest is the build manifest. This is a byproduct of the source-copy step, not the actual defect (the defect is that the <Extensions> were never merged into the build manifest, which is addressed as a skill-defect + coverage-gap).
items.covered_clearly_at: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md 'Manifest migration checklist' establishes that the scaffold's root Package.appxmanifest is the build manifest to edit; the nested copy is reference material.
items.why_no_skill_change: The nested-copy artifact itself is harmless and scenario-specific; the substantive, general failure (extensions not merged into the build manifest) is already captured as a skill-defect + coverage-gap, so no separate slip-oriented skill edit is warranted.
